end_goal: Enable explicitly selected, citation-preserving fiscal relationship expansion for the Kansas fiscal document store using reviewed, published StateCivics canonical evidence, while preserving ordinary document search and existing court, Topeka, and Grant behavior.

file_modification_map.what: Reconcile the existing proposal in place into the fiscal v1 projection contract, with exact provenance, lifecycle, type-specific eligibility, negative-decision, and activation boundaries.
Document the fiscal v1 contract and the distinct fixture, identity-proof, publication, and activation gates without changing the Grant contract.

Own fiscal-only constants, validation, coverage, and bounded expansion. Mirror expand_grant_graph's Principal, caller filters, chunks, hydrate callback, and return metadata seam so tenant/business/groups/roles and column filters constrain SQL and authorized hydration. Read fiscal generation_id and derivation_run_id from file_attribute_filters, require both on seeds, nodes, edges, and hydrated current files, and report both without removing caller filters. The initially enabled relation vocabulary is exactly describes_dimension and parent_dimension.

Convert an explicit structured relationship export or labeled fixture into deterministic bounded JSONL while preserving source revision, span, eligibility, lifecycle, evidence class, and derivation identity.
Validate and submit a fiscal artifact through the existing graph API, default to dry-run, and reject activation without resolved runtime identity and non-fixture publication proof.

Produce separate fixture and real-corpus proof records; treat counts as dated observations and require identity, derivation, bounds, citations, lifecycle, and applicable type-specific eligibility evidence.
Keep portable source configuration independent of runtime-observed IDs, expose the projection-binding file attributes, and disallow placeholder fallback for graph activation.
Register the fiscal handler/corpus pair and retain exact tenant, business, store, corpus, and profile binding with disabled-by-default behavior.
Add the explicit fiscal_relationships lens with only describes_dimension and parent_dimension and a 0..10 one-hop limit; leave semantic and other domain lenses unchanged.

Dispatch fiscal validation and expansion only through the registered fiscal profile and explicit lens, while reusing the PostgreSQL loader and preserving court, Topeka, Grant, and ordinary semantic-search paths.
Keep portable graph configuration disabled until a separately recorded runtime identity check proves the actual store; never encode document or chunk counts as configuration constants.
Declare fixture/eval/release commands and proof paths while retaining graph.enabled=false until real-corpus gates pass.

Provide a portable disabled fiscal profile example with a placeholder store identity. An operator renders a separate local runtime manifest only after read-only identity proof and selects that one strict CellGraphProfile through SVS_CELL_GRAPH_PROFILE_PATH; the existing Kansas court profile remains unchanged.

Prove fiscal validation, citation and ACL fidelity, bounds, replacement and withdrawal, explicit routing, fixture activation rejection, and negative crosswalk semantics; future-chain fixtures remain non-runtime characterization.
Provide a small synthetic fixture_only artifact for ontology projection and isolated crosswalk negative cases; it is never publication or activation evidence.
Retain Grant binding, validation, expansion, and semantic-default regression coverage alongside fiscal registration.
Retain court, Topeka, Grant, ordinary fiscal semantic search, and explicit-only fiscal expansion routing coverage.
Verify disabled fixture configuration and production activation proof requirements without treating open ticket state or observed counts as publication proof.

anti_duplication_rules: All fiscal graph validation and fiscal relationship eligibility checks go through packages/svs_common/svs_common/fiscal_graph.py:validate_fiscal_graph; do not widen Grant constants or duplicate fiscal checks in API routes or release scripts.

All fiscal expansion goes through packages/svs_common/svs_common/fiscal_graph.py:expand_fiscal_graph with the caller Principal, chunks, filters, and hydrate callback. Bind tenant, business, groups, roles, column filters, fiscal generation_id, and fiscal derivation_run_id in SQL, then rehydrate through the supplied authorized hydrator; do not add unscoped traversal or discard caller filters.

Keep the initial runtime relation allowlist exactly describes_dimension and parent_dimension. Crosswalk negative cases and the SB 125 account/payment/outcome chain may appear only in explicitly fixture_only characterization until each relation has an explicit cited structured upstream export and its own eligibility gate.

Apply ontology publication_status/resolution_status/lifecycle_status rules only to ontology dimensions. Apply AccountCrosswalk status/publication_allowed/review/effective-period/source/current-revision rules to crosswalks, and never emit not_same as a positive edge.
Keep portable profile and source-package configuration separate from runtime-observed store IDs, document counts, and chunk counts; record observations only in dated evaluation proof.

Leave instances/ks-state-civics/graph/profile.yaml unchanged because it is the Kansas court manifest. Keep one portable disabled fiscal example under the fiscal source package; after read-only identity proof, an operator renders a separate local manifest with the real store ID and selects that single strict manifest through SVS_CELL_GRAPH_PROFILE_PATH. Do not add multi-profile loader behavior.
Use the existing VectorStoreGraphLoadRequest and PostgreSQL graph loader; do not create a competing request envelope, graph database, or direct StateCivics database write path.

Do not enable the fiscal profile or describe real-corpus support from ticket status, fixtures, document counts, or narrative exports. Require a dated inspection of actual structured export rows and matching identity, citation, derivation, lifecycle, and type-specific eligibility fields.

Preserve ordinary semantic search and existing Grant, court, and Topeka branches; fiscal expansion is entered only through the explicit fiscal_relationships lens and an exact eligible fiscal profile binding.

tickets.expected_output: WAVE-130 and CELL_GRAPH_PROFILES define one consistent fiscal v1 projection contract. They distinguish ontology eligibility from AccountCrosswalk eligibility, bind every assertion to current ExAIS documents and exact StateCivics revision/span evidence, retain not_same only as an upstream negative decision, keep describes_dimension/parent_dimension as the initial runtime vocabulary, and state that the larger SB 125 chain awaits structured cited exports.

A fiscal_graph module plus extract/load commands accept bounded deterministic fixtures now and explicit structured exports later, validate one derivation run, exact current-document citations, ACL, lowercase hashes, lifecycle, dangling references, <10000 nodes, <20000 edges, and 0..10 one-hop expansion through the existing loader. Expansion mirrors the Grant Principal/filter/hydrate interface, extracts fiscal generation and derivation identities from caller file_attribute_filters, binds both throughout SQL, and preserves caller ACL and column filters during authorized hydration. The runtime projection emits only eligible describes_dimension and parent_dimension edges.

The fiscal handler and explicit fiscal_relationships lens route only an exact, enabled, non-fixture fiscal profile through fiscal validation and bounded expansion. cell_graph_profile_for_store receives Principal, vector_store_id, and file attributes: Principal supplies tenant/business scope while attributes supply corpus and graph_profile_id. A portable disabled fiscal profile example is separate from the unchanged Kansas court manifest; runtime selects one operator-rendered strict manifest through SVS_CELL_GRAPH_PROFILE_PATH, without multi-profile loader changes. Semantic search and Grant, court, and Topeka routing retain their prior behavior.

Release tooling resolves and checks runtime store identity read-only, emits dated identity/publication evidence separately from portable config, rejects the placeholder and same-named mismatches, and leaves graph.enabled=false until a non-fixture structured export passes applicable gates. Only after proof does an operator bind the real store ID in a separate local rendered manifest selected through SVS_CELL_GRAPH_PROFILE_PATH; the checked-in portable example is never activation evidence and the court manifest remains unchanged.

Executable tests and a fixture_only artifact prove ontology success, malformed/ineligible rejection, citations, ACL isolation, current-document joins, bounds, one-hop caps, replacement, withdrawal, explicit routing, and semantic-search isolation. Separate crosswalk fixtures prove positive eligibility and that not_same, candidate, ambiguous, unknown, unresolved, disallowed, unreviewed, rejected, or superseded decisions produce no positive edge; any SB 125 payment/outcome fixture is labeled future characterization and cannot activate runtime support.
